description: This file implements the NotificationHandler class for managing and sending notifications related to device status and parameter changes, including queue management, callback registration, and JSON payload creation.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Singleton class managing device notifications, including queue handling, callback registration, and notification dispatching.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for notification updates.

methods.name: pushNotification
methods.description: Pushes a notification with specified destination and payload into the queue and triggers callback.

methods.name: pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Creates and pushes a value change notification based on event data.

methods.name: pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Creates and pushes a key-value notification.

methods.name: push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Creates and pushes device management status notifications.

methods.name: push_device_deepsleep_notifications
